changeSet.author: thalabi
changeSet.createView: WITH latest_date AS ( SELECT max(exchange_rate.as_of_date) AS as_of_date FROM exchange_rate WHERE exchange_rate.from_currency::text = 'USD'::text AND exchange_rate.to_currency::text = 'CAD'::text ), rate_on_latest_date AS ( SELECT er.rate FROM exchange_rate er JOIN latest_date ON er.as_of_date = latest_date.as_of_date AND er.from_currency::text = 'USD'::text AND er.to_currency::text = 'CAD'::text ), cad_and_usd_values AS ( SELECT po.position_snapshot, sum(po.quantity * pr.price) AS market_value FROM "position" po JOIN instrument i ON po.instrument_id = i.id JOIN price pr ON po.price_id = pr.id WHERE i.currency::text = 'CAD'::text GROUP BY po.position_snapshot UNION ALL SELECT po.position_snapshot, sum(po.quantity * pr.price * (( SELECT rate_on_latest_date.rate FROM rate_on_latest_date))) AS market_value FROM "position" po JOIN instrument i ON po.instrument_id = i.id JOIN price pr ON po.price_id = pr.id WHERE i.currency::text = 'USD'::text GROUP BY po.position_snapshot ) SELECT row_number() OVER (ORDER BY cad_and_usd_values.position_snapshot) AS id, cad_and_usd_values.position_snapshot, sum(cad_and_usd_values.market_value) AS market_value FROM cad_and_usd_values GROUP BY cad_and_usd_values.position_snapshot ORDER BY cad_and_usd_values.position_snapshot;
